visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a blue t-shirt and grey shorts sits on a white stool in a bright indoor room. He holds a professional black microphone close to his mouth with his right hand, expressing varied facial expressions from inquisitive to passionate. Behind him is a white wall with a round gold-rimmed mirror and a wooden shelf filled with cosmetic products and books. (2) The camera maintains a medium shot as the man continues to sing with high emotional engagement, often closing his eyes and using his left hand for emphasis. He looks around as if checking the atmosphere of the room. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of his clothing and the surrounding objects on the shelf. (3) The man leans forward slightly, clutching his chest with one hand while singing with a pained, dramatic expression. He gestures broadly with his free hand towards the camera. The background remains consistent, showing an open doorway leading to another room and various household items like boxes and canisters on the shelf. (4) A woman wearing a red checkered shirt and a Shin-chan apron enters the frame from the right, carrying a large plate of food. The man stops his dramatic singing, looking surprised and then suspicious. He takes the plate, bringing it close to his face to smell it, his expression shifting to one of mild disgust or disappointment.
